verdict.rationale: The evidence documents bidirectional links, backlinks and filtered search, but nothing shows an interactive visual graph of notes and connections. The API's "/graphs" endpoints refer to the user's note workspace, not a visualization. Filtered search lists and backlink lists are adjacent features, not the graph-exploration capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can explore my knowledge base as an interactive graph of notes and connections, filtered to what I care about
